title: hypericum aviculariifolium var. leprosum
intro: Hypericum aviculariifolium var. leprosum, commonly known as St. John's Wort, is a plant species in the genus Hypericum, native to South America. It is traditionally used for its medicinal properties, including the treatment of anxiety and depression, due to its health benefits such as its ability to reduce stress and promote relaxation. The therapeutic actions of St. John's Wort include its antidepressant and antiviral properties, which are attributed to its bioactive constituents such as hyperforin, hypericin, and flavonoids. The bioactive constituents of St. John's Wort are responsible for its therapeutic effects, including its ability to inhibit the reuptake of neurotransmitters such as serotonin and dopamine, and its antioxidant properties.
